description: Execute a chain of workflows in sequence. Each step runs after the previous completes. Use inputFrom and outputTo to pass the output image from one step to the next (e.g. txt2img → upscale → img2img). Steps can use workflow JSON or saved workflow name. Prefer saved workflow name (string) for large workflows to avoid ENAMETOOLONG in some clients. Requires COMFYUI_HOST.

inputFrom.description: Take image from this previous step

outputIndex.description: Zero-based image index in the selected output node images array

outputTo.description: Input name in this workflow to set with image (e.g. image for LoadImage)

params.description: Override node inputs: { nodeId: { inputName: value } }

stop_on_error.description: Stop chain on first failure (default false)

name: execute_chain
